headline: CIN @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 3.80 at STL 5.27, with a projected total of 9.07. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward STL: CIN moved +0.23 runs while STL moved +1.54, changing the projected margin by -1.31 runs. The projected total climbed +1.77, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -16.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Michael McGreevy has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, JJ Bleday, Lars Nootbaar, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nolan Gorman, Eugenio Suárez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
